serie-9-1: Indoors, an empty living room with a drop cloth on the floor: a male house painter in white overalls stands on a small stepladder and paints a wall blue with a paint roller; half of the wall is already blue, the other half still white; a paint tray and a bucket of blue paint on the floor.

serie-10-3: Inside a car repair garage: a mechanic in a blue work overall bends over the open hood of a car and repairs the engine with a wrench; tools hang on the wall behind him; the car is stationary, no hose, no fuel pump.
